name: COMET/Excel with active companion services
status: proposed physical design, empirical V&V not executed
scope: 40 active FRs, six logical components, Pre-Phase A through adapted C, model/MIL/F Prime host software only
retention_rationale: COMET requirement/parameter and workbook records combine with sourced sizing, battery mapping and evidence methods. Contextual guidance, whole-CUBICS/F Prime adapters and controlled releases are proposed additions.

allocations.planned_check: I,T: Round-trip quantitative and qualitative records, including unresolved criteria.
A,T: Compare clean and seeded drafts with an independent expert reference, including valid similar requirements and missed defects.
A,T: Use contextual queries whose eligible methods change with inputs, maturity or intended use.
T: Compare both query directions and coverage with a known relationship set.
A,T: Compare the impact set of coupled load, pointing and interface changes with an expert reference.
T: Accept, decline and interrupt changes without erasing the predecessor.
I,T: Reconstruct predecessor and successor manifests and all applicable products.
T: Inject identity, unit, sign and revision mismatches at each active interface.
I,T: Trace successful, failed, cancelled and partial outputs to their configurations.
D,T: Independently replay in the declared host environment and compare under fixed tolerances.
T: Seed every evidence status and attempt a current claim with a blocking gap.
A,T: Recalculate mass and volume after a component substitution and preserve unknown properties and aggregation assumptions.
A,T: Use infeasible and closely ranked alternatives with uncertain inputs.
I,D: Configure alternate EPS topologies and retain the distinct allocation and extension revisions.

A,T: Use whole-CUBICS histories with a temporal shortage hidden by an average budget. Perturb load, mode or illumination and compare the mapped EPS numerical response with an independent reference within model scope.
A,T: Recalculate an allocation and follow it to the parent and source quantities.

D,T: Exercise each discipline profile and incompatible mappings. Perturb an incoming whole-CUBICS history, compare the EPS numerical effect independently and return its identified response to the same scenario. Scene-only updates or missing numerical exchange cannot pass. Retain failed/partial status and transfer limits.
D,T: Run declared nominal and fault sequences with a simulated plant and retain stimuli, expected/actual state/event responses and failed criteria for matched SIL comparison.
A,T: Compare sizing and energy balance with independent calculations, including an infeasible eclipse case.
I,T: Attempt conclusions outside validity and with missing independent evidence.
A,T: Calibrate from supplied data, retain separate assessment data and decline an update.
I,T: Change the time step, solver and resource limits and inspect the run configuration and findings.

A,T: Execute released F Prime host software with simulated EPS/subsystem products connected to the same whole-CUBICS scenario. Use matched MIL results and fixed comparison rules. Seed a code/interface discrepancy and failed/partial runs. Retain raw host responses, requirement/ConOps outcomes, differences, status and limits. Builds and scene updates supply no SIL evidence.
I,T: Revise a degraded mode and trace its requirement and analysis inputs.
I,T: Assess applicability with and without repair or redundancy assumptions.
A,T: Compare transformations and results with a reference and leave missing rates unresolved.
I,T: Distinguish planned activities from results and verification criteria from validation expectations.
I,T: Exercise all dispositions and an unauthorized attempt to apply a suggestion.
T: Edit during a delayed response and check that the old response cannot replace current guidance.

A,T: Seed clock offset, delayed/out-of-order samples and missing timing. Compare checked alignments, delays and exceeded/unknown limits with fixed timing references. Distinguish scenario/sample/receipt times, scene update rate and numerical time step.

T: Seed wrong entity/channel/revision, unit/sign/frame mismatch and missing, inactive or invalid samples. Compare admission findings and masks with a fixed reference before numerical use. Preserve raw histories and unchanged controlled content for rejected transfers.

I,T: Round-trip endpoint ownership/directions and all interface and ground-definition fields. Reject inconsistent identifiers, types, units, ranges, polarity and temporal meanings against an independent reference. Structural checks supply no behavior verdict.

D,T: Compare required F Prime component/instance/port/topology and command/telemetry/event/parameter mappings with an independent reference at declared actual profile/tool/representation versions. Seed conflicts, wrong directions/types, missing meanings and incompatible versions. Retain unsupported behavior and lossy translations.
A,T: Exercise nominal, rejected, protection and recovery sequences in simulated conditions.

D,T: Reject stale, unreleased and unauthorized design requests. Coordinate an authorized current-release F Prime host build, retaining exact source/build, toolchain/dependency/host revisions, logs and generation/compilation failures. Review acceptance cannot replace exact authorization. Build success supplies no SIL verdict.
I,D: Compare views with their source baseline and follow represented record links.
I,D: Prepare phase-specific packages, including CDR design release and SIR released-product evidence.
A,D: Change maturity and blocking findings and inspect the revised activity proposals.
T: Measure response delay under the declared workload, including outage and superseded edits.
I,T: Reject unauthorized or stale-baseline decisions and exercise blocking and conditional findings.

comparison_mechanisms.mechanism: COMET requirement/parameter records feed quality rules and companion semantic checks.
Catalogue and parameter context feed sourced method selection and eligibility checks.
COMET categories/workbook quantities -> Python EPS/battery analysis -> battery USD mappings adapted to numerical whole-CUBICS Omniverse.
COMET requirement/parameter/workbook interface records -> new checked adapters -> required versioned F Prime profile.
COMET parameter, catalogue and workbook revisions invalidate current/pending advice before latest-context checks.
COMET server/study/catalogue snapshots, Excel workbooks, add-in versions, Python/numerical dependencies and raw outputs.

record.placement_and_authority: COMET server/database at the engineering service. Excel/desktop plus companion Python on the participant host. Requirement fields belong to the companion, parameter/budget fields to COMET/Excel, and released snapshots to the archive. Current API/add-in/Excel compatibility, legal access and workbook reconstruction are unknown.

components.tools: COMET desktop/Excel receiving adapters and Python views
components.obligation: Check every external mapping for stable identities, revisions, structure, units, polarity and time/mode meaning. Preserve rejected raw transfers. Views resolve one controlled baseline.

components.tools: Python assistance linked to COMET/Excel edits
components.obligation: Active Python drafting rules, BM25/local pinned Qwen retrieval/reranking, optional admitted pinned Jev scoring, controlled applicability and separate cited rule/source/context explanations. Retain uncertainty, no eligible/unavailable status and human dispositions.

components.tools: Companion requirement records linked to COMET parameter IDs
components.obligation: Retain requirement meaning and proposed derivation/allocation. Reviewed record changes preserve unresolved fields and exact parents. Similarity and imported functions are not requirement derivation.

components.tools: COMET server/desktop and Excel parameter budgets plus proposed EPS/control models
components.obligation: Own mission/ConOps, modeled component occurrences, variants, BOM quantities and sourced budgets/sizing, dated EPS acquisition estimates, feasibility-first trades and detailed control/interface definitions.

components.tools: Python specialist adapters and analysis plans
components.obligation: Plan declared coupled numerical, RAM and MIL profiles. Coordinate external models and exact released host coding/build/SIL. Preserve solver/coupling/resources, matched stimuli and replay rules. Every mandatory discipline profile needs verification.

Check intended use, fidelity, omissions, validity, numerics and history quality. Preserve raw values and masks, sample/receipt times and residual units. Separate supplied-data calibration proposals from independent assessment.

components.tools: Python EPS assessment and COMET-linked review views
components.obligation: Plan EPS verification/validation against separate requirements/expectations. Assess critical gaps, prepare scoped review packages and record only current designated-authority decisions. Prepared is not accepted.

components.tools: Reviewed COMET/Excel snapshots, Git manifests and managed archive
components.obligation: Git and a managed raw-result/source archive preserve exact revisions, impacts, predecessors and authorized successors. Rebuildable indexes do not own engineering fields. Invalidate edited/pending guidance immediately and recheck latest context before display/application.
